# Hi, I'm Nadhira! 👋 {.home-title .no-anchor}

I'm currently studying Quantitative Methods in the Social Sciences at Columbia University. I have 5+ years of experience across tech, banking, and logistics and supply chain, where I built analytics dashboards and ran experiments to help businesses grow.

I'm interested in data science, spatial analytics, and causal inference. Here I share my projects and what I'm learning along the way.
